character.description: Compact Vietnamese fishmonger uncle with graying tousled hair, curled moustache, navy shirt, teal apron, striped towel and rubber boots; funny winking smile.

chroma_key.name: magenta
chroma_key.selection_reason: highest 1st-percentile subject distance among the 4 candidate(s) clearing the 96 erase radius

idle.action: Four small front-facing idle beats with boots planted: proud hands-on-hips stance, a quick moustache twitch and blink, a cheeky wink with a small nod, then return to the opening stance. Subtle breathing only between gestures; keep the same scale and foot line.

work.action: A clear repeating fishmonger sales loop, front-facing and planted at the stall: he holds one small silver fish in both hands at waist height, lifts and presents it toward the customer, gives a proud wink and nod, then lowers it back to the opening pose. Keep the same fish, hand placement, body size, outfit and boot line consistent; no scenery.

style: Hand-inked Vietnamese 2D mobile game sprite, matching the supplied character base exactly. Bold dark-brown comic contour, slightly irregular hand-drawn line, clear simplified shapes, warm limited colors and restrained matte cel shading; no glossy 3D finish. Compact chibi proportions, funny readable facial acting at small scale, stable full-body front view, same height and outfit in every cell. Single character on transparent background, no scenery or text.
